models.title: Qwen3.5 9B
models.role: Code-aware evidence preparation and structured handoffs.
models.reason: Its published coding and instruction-following results make it a useful reference candidate. The local trial must still establish whether it preserves the facts our host needs.
models.limits: Q4_K_M is a quantized tag. Author results do not certify this quantization, its memory headroom or its thinking settings. Recorded task qualification is pending.

models.title: Gemma 4 12B
models.role: An alternative for code, documents and careful evidence preparation.
models.reason: A different model family gives us a useful comparison. Google's published code results justify a trial; they do not establish that it beats another candidate under our settings.
models.limits: Different publishers use different evaluation setups. Actual local memory and latency have not been measured. Image ingestion is not implemented in this workbench.

models.title: Qwen3.5 4B
models.role: A smaller candidate for focused triage and compact local preparation.
models.reason: A smaller model may reduce loading and preparation work. It must meet the same task accuracy requirements before speed is considered.
models.limits: Smaller does not mean equally accurate. No local task score, speed result or measured memory use is recorded. The automatic selector cannot promote it from a published score.
